column1: # Web-app manifest for build-webapps.sh (pake / Tauri standalone web apps).
# Whitespace-separated columns (spaces OR tabs both work):  name  url  wm_class  flags
#   name     : pake --name; also the binary name, the .desktop basename, and
#              (usually) the X11 WM_CLASS. Keep it == the old chromium .desktop
#              basename so `gtk-launch <name>` (e.g. the xmobar date click) keeps working.
#   wm_class : expected WM_CLASS for the built app (verify post-build with xprop;
#              correct it here if it differs, then re-run for that app).
#   flags    : extra space-separated pake flags, or "TEST" to mark apps that may
#              not work under WebKitGTK (heavy SPA/WASM, or possibly-dead service).
# spotify is intentionally absent: it needs Widevine DRM, which pake/WebKitGTK lacks
# (stay on the native spotify-launcher). claude.ai is also separate (profile-scoped scratchpad).
